outputs.pilot_threshold_rule: per site/duration the three median pilot Python 1000-event conditional quantiles; deduplicate exactly; freeze before reference and confirmation; if invalid stop

margins.scale: absolute median of 30 independent 1000-event screening quantiles per site/duration/target, from Python only, frozen before reference/confirmation

design.streams_python: independently generated uniform 64-bit roots with replacement; abort unresolved on duplicate root or overlapping identities; existing HMAC domain separation; within-cohort independent pseudorandom draws an explicit computational assumption
design.streams_native: unverified; require source-backed independence and effective allocation before inference
design.selection: screening descriptive; freeze margins, estimands, reference and confirmation plans before reference/confirmation; confirmation fixed at 1000; alternative budgets need new protocol
design.stop: stop before launching any cohort that could breach cap; stop on cap/invalid counts/identity/missing inference prerequisites; no opportunistic CI stopping; report unresolved; native must first demonstrate a defensible pre-launch effective count bound; replay and expansion have no budget

inference.reference_method: Weighted Hoeffding on independent latent complete planned stratum indicators at pilot-frozen thresholds; observed certified endpoints, including all unknown planned draws as [0,+infinity], enclose latent empirical CDFs pointwise even under informative censoring. Fixed planned weights/counts and latent law required; union allocation and conservative grid inversion.
inference.reference_family_size_per_engine: K = 2 * sum(site,duration) unique frozen threshold count; max 512 initially
inference.native_print_precision: known convention interval per token or unavailable; propagate interval endpoints; never substitute exact zero
inference.reference_pooling: combine conditional CDF contributions using complete planned draw counts and frozen stratum weights, never average batch quantiles
inference.equivalence: simultaneous reference-region differences wholly within prespecified margins for quantiles, fixed CDF thresholds and zero mass; no whole-CDF claim; no separate alpha consumed for transformations of same joint regions
inference.single_run: definite pass if every output within margin for all reference/observation values; definite fail if no admissible reference/observation vector meets all margins; otherwise indeterminate; conservative rectangle check may return indeterminate
inference.reliability: On reference coverage, definite count <= latent iid whole-cohort true-pass count <= possible count; apply one-sided CP by monotonicity to full planned cohort denominator, including unstarted/aborted unknowns. Observed classifications need not be iid. Undefined latent law or failed enclosure => unresolved. Operational execution reliability separate. Adequacy if lower >= target; inadequacy if upper < target; else unresolved.
inference.coverage_power_validation: Separate 28 November synthetic qualification executed, 300-cohort alternative examined in dimensionless controls only; finite results and independent review pending; see ../../work/2026-11-28-issue148-synthetic-qualification.md. Physical study remains unfrozen and blocked; draft 100-cohort physical budget unchanged.

reference_grid.thresholds: 0, pooled weighted Python screening conditional attained quantiles at nonexceedance 0.01..1.00 by 0.01 (1.00=max), and max(0,m_j+k*Delta_j) for each of three pilot median peak quantiles and k in [-2,-1,-0.5,-0.25,0,0.25,0.5,1,2]; sort/deduplicate

inference.reference_half_width: sqrt(0.5 * sum_h(v_h^2/n_h) * log(2*K/alpha_ref)), v_h = w_h/0.49; n_h planned pooled independent reference count

rejected_uniform_dkw.reason: 50 strata x 10000 reference draws, 2 sites, 1 duration, alpha_h=0.00005; epsilon ~0.023 precludes finite 0.98/0.99 lower-CDF inverse and 0.01 joint difference margin

inference.quantile_bounds: max(0, greatest grid x with U(x)<1-a); least grid x with L(x)>=1-a or unbounded; monotonic tightening; no interpolation
